channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Trump seethes over Supreme Court justices who opposed him on tariffs, especially those he appointed
item.description: Legal opposition to the tariffs crossed political lines.

item.title: Justice Department swiftly fires lawyer chosen as top federal prosecutor for Virginia office
item.description: James Hundley was fired via social media Friday shortly after he was chosen by judges.

item.title: These Southern California museums are free to visit on Sunday
item.description: The return of So Cal Museums Free-for-All day on Feb. 22 means that you can get into normally pricey museums without paying admission.

item.title: This shiny Altadena bunny paves trail toward return of quirky museum lost in fire
item.description: The Bunny Museum gets one hop closer to reopening. They have steely-eyed security, with hopes of recovery and 'staying weird.'

item.title: 9 violations led to Moreno Valley Mall’s closure, councilmember says
item.description: Elena Baca-Santa Cruz says the mall lacks backup power generator, among other problems.

item.title: Genesis Invitational: Adam Scott hunting a 3rd Riviera title after 2nd-round 63
item.description: The tournament’s all-time leading money winner, it’s no surprise to see the Australian tied for fourth at 9-under-par 133, three shots behind co-leaders Marco Penge and Jacob Bridgeman. Rory McIlroy is one shot off the lead.

item.title: Lakers’ Luke Kennard emphasizes communication in return to L.A.
item.description: Kennard, who has played in all four games since being acquired in a trade with Atlanta earlier this month, says the Lakers have made his return to the region a smooth transition.

item.title: Bianco gets piled on for saying something reasonable on immigration
item.description: It seems like any hint of reasonableness on immigration is verboten in the absolute circus that is the current GOP.

item.title: IE Varsity’s CIF Southern Section playoff scoreboard for Friday, Feb. 20
item.description: See how Inland boys basketball team fared in CIF Southern Section playoff games Friday night.

item.title: Luka Doncic’s 38-point night helps Lakers hold off Clippers
item.description: Doncic, Austin Reaves and LeBron James combine for 80 points and 24 assists in just their 11th game together this season, as the Lakers blow a 16-point lead in the second half before surviving, 125-122, to split the four-game season series.
